the RcGTA is not a virus, but rather a gene transfer agent that can be used for horizontal gene transfer in Alphaproteo-bacteria.

many of the alphaproteobacteria genomes encode GTAs instead of viruses.
many Alphaproteo bacterial genomes encode RcGTA-like gene clusters, which may have been misidentified as prophages.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the RcGTA gene clusters are widespread among alphaproteobacteria and are often misinterpreted as viral prophages.
